description: Complete typed assessments retained separately from the concise public TD; applicability is not satisfaction.

assessments.rationale: Retain the normative Profile Policy 2.0 dependency and its independent claim-review evidence. A published TD, profile scope or native operation does not replace the applicable conformance process.
Conformance requires implementing the referenced Network Interface Specification Set, whose minimum is 2.6 in section 1.2. A TD cannot establish implementation-version compliance.

Implemented functions must follow the corresponding ONVIF service specification, including faults, lifecycle, ordering and data semantics. WSDL shape checking and TD affordances do not prove this; referenced service-body review and implementation evidence remain required.

Implement HTTP Digest according to the profile's RFC 2617/Core reference. SOAP access authorization is distinct from PACS credential recognition; no universal AuthenticationBehavior or camera service follows.
Signal the maximum supported user count through Device service capabilities. This does not expose user passwords or authorize user enumeration during discovery.
